summary: two data points have the same label
help: Rename one of the points, or merge them.
rationale: Identical labels render overlapping markers, which is usually a copy-paste mistake.

summary: quadrant chart has labels but no data points
help: Add at least one point line.
rationale: The plot parses, but it renders empty, so the missing data is easy to miss.

summary: quadrant chart has data points but no x-axis label
help: Add an x-axis line that names the axis.
rationale: The default axis text hides what the chart is comparing.

summary: quadrant chart has data points but no y-axis label
help: Add a y-axis line that names the axis.
rationale: The default axis text hides what the chart is comparing.

summary: the same quadrant region is labeled more than once
rationale: Mermaid keeps only the last label, so the earlier ones are silently dropped.
